PLAN "12-Week Muscle Gain - Plant-Based Female, 26"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS

    name "Lean muscle gain, 12 weeks. Nutrition target: 150g protein/day from strictly vegan sources (no animal products, fish, eggs, or dairy)."

    name "Progress main compound lifts with controlled load increases each phase."

    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper A":

          rowing 5m

          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60s
          lat_stretch 60s
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m

          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds

          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds

          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60s
          quad_stretch 60s
